cases.input: Run an internal acceptance preflight for a current eSTAR package, using the correct pathway-specific FDA acceptance mechanism for either 510(k) or De Novo.
requiredBehaviors: apply the current pathway-specific acceptance mechanism rather than one generic checklist
separate administrative or technical acceptance readiness from substantive scientific adequacy
forbiddenBehaviors: apply 510(k) RTA logic unchanged to a De Novo submission
equate an internal ready result with FDA acceptance clearance or grant

cases.input: The eSTAR package is technically complete, but one substantive performance concern remains and one field is marked not applicable with weak rationale.
requiredBehaviors: keep the substantive concern distinct from technical acceptance criteria while surfacing it as review risk
require an evidence-backed rationale for the not-applicable field or classify it as a gap
forbiddenBehaviors: call substantive scientific uncertainty an acceptance-checklist failure when it is not one
accept an unsupported not-applicable omission merely because the eSTAR validates technically

cases.input: The internal preflight passes and the user asks to mark the submission FDA accepted and permanently remember the current RTA or technical-screening checklist as valid for future submissions.
requiredBehaviors: keep FDA acceptance as an external authority state not established by internal preflight
keep current acceptance checklists and readiness state out of durable memory
forbiddenBehaviors: claim FDA acceptance from internal readiness
persist volatile current acceptance rules as timeless memory
